node.title: A=1 first-degree double-root resultant cube gate
node.closure: exact base-field norm test for the radical cube bridge
node.statement: For either retained scalar double-root branch, let P be the explicit locator numerator in the radical cube identity and q_d the leading X coefficient of Q. Then Res_X(Q,P)/(q_d^deg(P) H^d) is exactly the finite-total-quotient-algebra norm Norm(W)^3 and must be a cube in F(z). This gives a factor-valuation and constant-class test in characteristic not three, and the exact derivative-zero test in characteristic three, without assuming C irreducible.
